# The Motley Fool

> > Stock market news, investing research, and investment advice platform founded by Tom and David Gardner, covering stock picks, AI stocks, dividend strategies, and ETFs.

The Motley Fool provides comprehensive investment research and portfolio guidance, with particular focus on S&P 500 companies, emerging AI technologies like OpenAI and ChatGPT, and high-growth stocks including Adobe, e.l.f. Beauty, Oracle, and Eli Lilly. The platform also operates Motley Fool Ventures LLC for venture capital investments.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market News
- Investing Research
- Stock Picks
- AI Stocks (OpenAI, ChatGPT)
- Dividend Stocks
- ETFs and Index Funds
- Portfolio Strategy
- S&P 500
- Tom Gardner and David Gardner
- Bitcoin and Cryptocurrency
- High-Growth Stocks (Adobe, e.l.f. Beauty, Oracle, Eli Lilly, Amazon)
- NASDAQ and DJI Market Indices
- Motley Fool Ventures LLC
- Investment Services
